[Intro: string quartet, baroque-style progression, harpsichord]

[Chorus: mixed choir, patient and warm]
I'll hold the door, take your time
I got through, and I'm not leaving you behind
One foot, then the other, I can see you on the climb
I'll hold the door, take your time

[Verse 1: male rap, steady, encouraging]
First one in my family with a key to anything
Got a badge that opens glass and a phone that likes to ring
I could shut it right behind me, pull the ladder, lock the frame
A lot of people do. I know their names.
But I remember who it was that held it open first
A teacher with a Buick and a hole inside her purse
Drove me to the test and paid the fee and said, "Go in."
So every time it swings, I put my foot against the hinge.

[Chorus: mixed choir, patient and warm]
I'll hold the door, take your time
I got through, and I'm not leaving you behind
One foot, then the other, I can see you on the climb
I'll hold the door, take your time

[Verse 2: rap, warmer, drums fuller]
Kid from the building emailed, typos everywhere
I read it twice and wrote him back, "Come by, I'll be there"
He's got the look I had, like the room's about to know
He doesn't belong. I said, "Sit. Here's how this goes."
It ain't charity. It ain't a speech. It's a chair and a name
A call I make on Thursday and a ride out in the rain
If I get to the top and I'm the only one I see
Then nobody won, including me.

[Bridge: choir humming, strings alone, voice spoken]
Somebody held it for me.
Go on. I've got it.

[Final Chorus: full choir, organ, strings high]
I'll hold the door, take your time
I got through, and I'm not leaving you behind
